keys: OpenExo: An open-source modular exoskeleton to augment human function

interpretation.step: AnkleStep.mat and Step.mat encode ordered 100/200/300 triplets for prescribed torque, measured torque and within-cycle clock. Both channels are sign-reversed for ankle per the source notebooks. Keep all six nonzero command runs per joint, including the run that starts at the first observed row. Thresholds use the first observed samples reaching 10% and 90% of prescribed torque. Zero measured rise means both thresholds crossed between the same samples. Time in ms is local to each pulse.
interpretation.walking: Use every finite same-column value of LTorque and LSetP and the same ankle sign convention. The walking records are separate from the bench. The published analysis uses additional gait segmentation and selection. Our pooled errors include the low-assistance and zero-command portions.
interpretation.limitations: There is no identified upstream pre-clamp command plus downstream applied command in these four source files. Inline torque measurement and an open/closed-loop comparison do not establish a saturation episode. Fig. 3 reports averaged traces and distinct filtering/selection. Raw pulsewise threshold ranges should not be interpreted as a contradiction.
